name: CITY POP
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
tagline: Endless 1980s Japanese city pop. New song, new title, every few minutes.
description: CITY POP turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into an endless 1980s Japanese city pop band. Each song is written as it plays: lush seventh and ninth chords, the royal road and ii-V turns, intro, verse, pre-chorus, chorus, a bridge or solo, a key change up and a fade. Slap or fingered bass, Rhodes or DX piano, chorused guitar, brass, strings and a sung melody on synth lead or soprano sax. Then a new song with a new title. On screen a city at dusk over a car stereo: the reels turn, the sky drifts and the windows light up as the chorus arrives. Thirteen styles.
credits: Built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal, on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
